title: Del P's, Bama and blues trumpet
summary: Meeting Albert Delon, Bama, Papa Toot at Del P's; Bama's blues trumpet and scarcity of such players.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players
